name: @academix-admin/domain-types
description: Single source of truth for Academix domain types — generated Supabase row types + the RPC/Lambda wire contracts + shared status enums. Consumed across web, lambda, desktop; the canonical input for generating Dart (mobile) models. Git-tracked, not published to npm.

scripts.gen:db: supabase gen types typescript --project-id iewqfmkngcgayxbbnpiz --schema public > src/database.types.ts
scripts.verify: node scripts/gen.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- src/generated dart/lib/src
